## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/), e.g. `fix(maps): ...`

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] The documentation is updated if behavior changed
- [ ] Commits carry an `Assisted-by:` trailer if an AI tool materially shaped the change (see [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/michelin/TorchSOM/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#ai-assisted-contributions))
